children: Here's a list of key deals reported across sectors this week:
Zscaler
jumped 18% in after-hours trading on a report that CrowdStrike
is in talks to acquire the cybersecurity company. CrowdStrike fell 11%. The two companies are said to be discussing a potential deal that could come together soon.
MasTec
on Friday said it will acquire mechanical contractor Murphy for roughly $1.25 billion in cash.
Insmed
soared 15% on a report that Sanofi
is considering an acquisition of the drugmaker. Sanofi ADRs fell 3%. Sanofi
is speaking with advisers as it evaluates a possible deal for Insmed
Palo Alto Networks
agreed to buy startup Applied Compute for $4.5 billion in an all-stock deal. The deal is expected to close in Palo Alto's
fiscal Q3 of 2027.
Finland’s Iceye Oy has made a takeover offer for Italian rocket-launch company Avio SpA
, valuing it at €2.05B ($2.26B). The cash offer of €41 per share represents ~20% premium over Avio’s latest closing price.
Diamondback Energy
fell 1.3% pre-market Monday after saying it agreed to
​certain units of closely held oil driller Double Eagle in ‌the Permian Basin for ~$5B in cash and stock, confirming previous reports.
Canadian Natural Resources
said Monday it agreed to
Advantage Energy
for ~C$2.53 (US$1.77B) including debt, bolstering the company's position in western Canada.
Eli Lilly
is acquiring privately held Calytrix Bio in a deal that could be worth up to $1.5B to the biotech focused on rare blood disorder treatments.
